cluster_takeaways: Hero rule: home shows one big answer for today above the fold (Flo countdown circle, Oura 'One Big Thing', NC daily status); check that dulset's first screen has exactly one dominant number or sentence and nothing competing at the same size.
De-card the home: Oura's 2025 redesign dropped stacked cards for open whitespace grouping; Flo moved insights below the hero. Check: no more than 2-3 secondary blocks before the fold.

Cycle visual = a ring or arc for 'where am I now' plus a calendar for history; insights never overlay the ring (Flo design team). Check dulset uses one consistent cycle shape across her view, his view and widget.

Onboarding as a quiz that feels like a consultation (NC, Flo 30-55 steps, Finch chat mascot); each question visibly changes what the user sees next. Check: does dulset show a personalised result before asking for any account or invite?

Paywall sits after the quiz, never before the first value moment; couples apps that charge before partner pairing get criticised (Cozy Couples note). Check dulset monetisation point is after both partners are linked.

Partner gets his own mode with his own tips and pushes, not a mirror of her data (Flo for Partners; she picks what is shared and he is told when she changes mode). Check his screen copy is addressed to him.

Discretion is a design surface: alternate low-key app icon, discreet widget view, rewritable lock-screen notification text (Clue, Flo). Check every notification and widget string is safe on a locked screen.

Widgets and lock-screen widgets are retention tools with state-based art (Duolingo 4 widget families, Finch pet widgets, Flo watch award). Prototype gap: dulset (web) has none; plan at least one glanceable 'today' widget per partner.
Live Activities only for an ongoing task (e.g. a timed window), never promos; Duolingo was criticised for ads there in 2026.

Motion and haptics are tuned, not default: ADA 2026 Interaction winner Moonlitt spent months on slider feel and fingertip haptic ticks; Duolingo animates streak milestones. Check dulset has a designed completion moment.

Accessibility is now declared publicly: App Store Accessibility Nutrition Labels (2025) list VoiceOver, Larger Text to 200%, Dark Interface, Differentiate Without Color, Sufficient Contrast; Clue redesigned colours/calendar for low vision. Check fertile/period states are not colour-only and layouts survive 200% text.

Korean voice: all microcopy in 해요체, delete words not needed for meaning, soften error copy, one job per screen (Toss); a shared character or ritual that needs both partners drives couple retention (썸원 반려몽, user-set push time).
